*   Use when chunk plan swaps cause visible flicker due to missing bricks [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly states that 'Every refocus swaps the chunk plan, synchronously destroying unmatched bricks, and a brick with no resident texture draws nothing, so the scene background showed through until the re-stream landed.' It then describes the solution: 'NVChunkedVolume now fetches the coarsest pyramid level once and installs it as a whole-volume floor behind the octree... so fine detail dissolves in over the floor instead of popping.' This directly supports the claim that the technique is used to prevent visible flicker caused by chunk plan swaps.
